description.en:
Maker H01 is GigaAI's mobile, dual-arm robot for developing embodied-intelligence applications. The platform combines a wheeled base with articulated arms and a roughly adult-height body, allowing it to reposition for tasks such as picking up objects, inspections, reception and laboratory assistance.

GigaAI connects the hardware to GigaBrain for perception, task planning and control, and to GigaWorld for generating and using training data. This links physical data collection with model development and deployment. The intended settings include homes, commercial services, light industry and research; the ability to complete a particular sequence depends on the trained model, sensor configuration and task environment.
